summary: Verified the mobile-vs-desktop smooth-scroll/snap change for the network panels. Mobile (390x844) confirmed: window.__smoothScroll is undefined, html has no 'lenis' class, native scroll — scrolling stops exactly where the user releases (no glide/snap: scrollTo(676) stayed at 676 across two 400/800ms samples), all 4 network panels acquire .network-panel--revealed with h3 opacity=1 and both EXPLORE / GET IN TOUCH .np-btn buttons at opacity=1 after transition delays settle, footer-scroll-top scrolls back to scrollY=0. Desktop (1920x800) regression clean: html.lenis=true, window.__smoothScroll.lenis exists, snap engaged (scroll landing near panel2 offsetTop 1875 settled at 1775 post-snap window), all 4 panels reveal in both forward and reverse scroll directions, footer-scroll-top returns to scrollY=0. No console errors on either viewport (only a benign Lenis position warning on mobile-desktop transition load, unrelated).
critical_code_review_comments: smoothScroll.js correctly guards with matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)') and prefers-reduced-motion; smoothScrollTo falls back to window.scrollTo when lenis is null — behaviour matches requirements.

Reveal logic in NetworkExperience is scroll-event driven with rAF throttling and works with native scroll on mobile — confirmed by opacity=1 checks after 1500ms wait (transition delay up to 0.62s + 0.55s duration).

Minor console warning on mobile load: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' — appears to be a Lenis/library warning surfaced during hydration before the mobile guard skips init; non-blocking but could be silenced by returning earlier.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_12 verified the mobile-native-scroll vs desktop-lenis-snap split at the 900px breakpoint. All 5 acceptance criteria from the review pass. Note the button reveal on mobile takes ~1.2s after scroll due to CSS transition-delay stacking (--rd up to 0.62s); tests must wait >=1200ms for np-btn opacity to settle.
